overview_description.description: Piazza is a learning platform designed to connect students, TAs, and professors in order for every student to get help whenever they need it. Users can start a class at Piazza.com and collaborate in real time with classmates and instructors to find the answers they need.

product.name: Piazza Q&A
product.description: An online platform for class Q&A that enables students, TAs, and instructors to post, answer, and collaborate on questions in a shared space.

product.name: Piazza Network
product.description: A careers-oriented platform that connects students who opt in with employers for job opportunities and career guidance.

product.name: Piazza Talent
product.description: A recruiting service that helps employers connect with student talent from the Piazza user base, focusing on diversity and inclusion in hiring.
